description: Read curated, source-linked operating KPI observations for one exact Bullrun ticker. Coverage is sparse and no automatic KPI feed is configured: do not assume ARR, retention, customer counts or payments metrics are available. Check get_company_data_coverage first. Returns stored fiscal periods, units and source links; company-economics observations are a separate dataset. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

category.description: Optional category filter such as SaaS, payments, marketplace, banking, or other domain labels.

metricKey.description: Optional metric key present in stored coverage. No particular business KPI is guaranteed to be available.

ticker.description: The ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun, e.g. "CRWD", "SNOW", "V".

name: get_operating_kpis
title: Get operating KPIs
